t: 西班牙与荷兰共和国签署"安特卫普条约",启动十二年停战.
te: Spain and the Dutch Republic sign the Treaty of Antwerp to initiate twelve years of truce.
dz: 八十年战争:西班牙与荷兰共和国签署"安特卫普条约",启动十二年停战.
de: Eighty Years' War: Spain and the Dutch Republic sign the Treaty of Antwerp to initiate twelve years of truce.

t: 日本克什岛南部的萨特苏马地盘的岛津德松(Shimazu Tadatsune)成功入侵了冲绳的里…

dz: 日本克什岛南部的萨特苏马地盘的岛津德松(Shimazu Tadatsune)成功入侵了冲绳的里京王国.
de: Daimyō (Lord) Shimazu Tadatsune of the Satsuma Domain in southern Kyūshū, Japan, completes his successful invasion of the Ryūkyū Kingdom in Okinawa.

t: 莎士比亚的"相声"最早由出版商托马斯·索普在伦敦出版,可能是非法出版.
te: Shakespeare's sonnets are first published in London, perhaps illicitly, by the publisher Thomas Thorpe.
dz: 莎士比亚的"相声"最早由出版商托马斯·索普在伦敦出版,可能是非法出版.
de: Shakespeare's sonnets are first published in London, perhaps illicitly, by the publisher Thomas Thorpe.

t: 第二次"弗吉尼亚宪章"正式批准.
te: Official ratification of the Second Virginia Charter takes place.
dz: 第二次"弗吉尼亚宪章"正式批准.
de: Official ratification of the Second Virginia Charter takes place.

t: 波希米亚通过神圣罗马皇帝鲁道夫二世的陛下信授予宗教自由.
te: Bohemia is granted freedom of religion through the Letter of Majesty by the Holy Roman Emperor, Rudolf II.
dz: 波希米亚通过神圣罗马皇帝鲁道夫二世的陛下信授予宗教自由.
de: Bohemia is granted freedom of religion through the Letter of Majesty by the Holy Roman Emperor, Rudolf II.

t: 前往弗吉尼亚的英国"海上风险号"(Sea Venture)号船在百慕大遭遇风暴期间被故意开上岸…
te: The English ship Sea Venture, en route to Virginia, is deliberately driven ashore during a storm at Bermuda to prevent …
dz: 前往弗吉尼亚的英国"海上风险号"(Sea Venture)号船在百慕大遭遇风暴期间被故意开上岸来防止其下沉;幸存者继续在那里找到一个新的殖民地.
de: The English ship Sea Venture, en route to Virginia, is deliberately driven ashore during a storm at Bermuda to prevent its sinking; the survivors go on to found a new colony there.

t: 在Ticonderoga(现为Crown Point,纽约),Samuel de Champl…
te: At Ticonderoga (now Crown Point, New York), Samuel de Champlain shoots and kills two Iroquois chiefs on behalf of his n…
dz: Beaver Wars: 在Ticonderoga(现为Crown Point,纽约),Samuel de Champlain代表他的本土盟友拍摄并杀死了两名易洛魁酋长.
de: Beaver Wars: At Ticonderoga (now Crown Point, New York), Samuel de Champlain shoots and kills two Iroquois chiefs on behalf of his native allies.

t: 伽利略向威尼斯立法者展示他的第一台望远镜。
te: Galileo Galilei demonstrates his first telescope to Venetian lawmakers.
dz: 伽利略向威尼斯立法者展示他的第一台望远镜。
de: Galileo Galilei demonstrates his first telescope to Venetian lawmakers.

t: 亨利·哈德逊发现了特拉华湾.
dz: 亨利·哈德逊发现了特拉华湾.

t: 亨利·哈德逊抵达了曼哈顿岛,并会见了住在那里的原住民.
te: Henry Hudson arrives on Manhattan Island and meets the indigenous people living there.
dz: 亨利·哈德逊抵达了曼哈顿岛,并会见了住在那里的原住民.
de: Henry Hudson arrives on Manhattan Island and meets the indigenous people living there.

dz: 亨利·哈德逊在"Halve Maen"号上开始探索哈德逊河.
de: Henry Hudson begins his exploration of the Hudson River while aboard the Halve Maen.

t: 亨利·哈德逊(Henry Hudson)到达了后来会以他命名的河流——哈德逊河.
te: Henry Hudson reaches the river that would later be named after him – the Hudson River.
dz: 亨利·哈德逊(Henry Hudson)到达了后来会以他命名的河流——哈德逊河.
de: Henry Hudson reaches the river that would later be named after him – the Hudson River.
